metadata.note: Use this file for labels and relationships to look for, not generated node IDs, ordering, or exact raw graph text.

semantic_edges.relationship: loaded Iris measurements are converted into the base dataframe
species labels are joined onto the base measurements
joined rows are filtered for complete measurement values
bad intermediate is derived from the cleaned dataframe with an impossible species filter
cleaned rows are filtered to flowers with wider petals
filtered rows are aggregated by species
summary rows are ranked and annotated for the final report
